dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Clarify bridge_pause docstring that idempotence holds only when the pause reason matches the existing pause.
evidence: src/rebar/_lib_ops.py:245: `"""Persist an idempotent reconciliation pause through the shared CAS ref."""`
src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_ref_lock.py:696: `elif existing["reason"] == reason:` returns old (idempotent) — otherwise `raise _pause_conflict(...)`
dropped.finding: bridge_pause docstring claims the pause is 'idempotent', but set_pause only returns the existing OID (no-op) when the reason matches; a pause with a different reason raises RefLockError via _pause_conflict. The behavior is conditional idempotence, not unconditional as the docstring implies.
